[2] Watch Rumble's Heat bar carefully. If you see him Overheat, go in for the kill while his skills are disabled.
[2] When you see the missiles falling, move out of the way as quickly as possible.
[2] In lane try to wait until Rumble uses Flamespitter and/or Scrap Shield before taking the offensive.
[2] Avoid tight paths which will make moving away from it impossible along the path.
[2] Be careful after avoiding his Electro Harpoon, as he can still fire another one even if he overheats.
